quotaDecision.observe: Record visible quota/limits before and after identical short proofreading. If not exposed, use not-visible rather than zero. Do not exhaust quotas or invoke generative actions as a proxy.
quotaDecision.inference: An unchanged meter on a short sample establishes only that observation, not perpetual unlimited entitlement.

resultProtocol.noFeedback: Record the result and investigate settings. Never convert absence on one sample into universal absence.
resultProtocol.evidence: Screenshot/file references and exact text; avoid emails, keys or account IDs.
resultProtocol.review: Completed worksheet is evidence intake only. It does not approve editorial fit, qualification, graph import or publishing.
